basic_info.description: Not a BMR! An incredible opportunity to own a charming slice of San Francisco in one of the city's most iconic neighborhoods. This studio is full of classic Nob Hill character with hardwood floors, wainscoting, and a clawfoot tub with shower. A great option for anyone looking for a pied-a-terre, a crash pad for city visits, or an investor looking to build their portfolio. The building offers a rooftop deck with BBQ and Golden Gate Bridge views, shared free laundry, secure entry, and an elevator. Located near Huntington Park, Grace Cathedral, and neighborhood favorites like Nob Hill Cafe and Trader Joe's. Enjoy easy access to cable cars and multiple Muni lines.
